provenance.choice_policy: Preserve the Amber family's three random distinct non-gold three-digit distractors; independently balance gold positions for every task and split.
provenance.heldout_contract: One global partition of 224 unique input triples is shared across stages: 128 train, 32 validation, 64 test. No test triple occurs in training or validation for any stage.
provenance.primary_metric: Four-choice continuation accuracy, with uniform random choice accuracy 0.25; not free-generation accuracy.
provenance.student_context: Only the named task and input triple; no hidden mapping, examples, previous episode, or demonstrations.
provenance.validation_use: Fixed-step learning curves only. Validation does not select the final checkpoint or alter the 64-example test set.
